about: A percentage meeting a plain number: converted to a pure number, and the operand rule sees two units.

files.model.yaml:
dsl: 2
model: tiny
title: percent plus one
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  stored:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB
    value: 15
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "what is held, as stated for this case"}

  index:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: GB
    value: 500
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the index, as stated for this case"}

  disk_per_host:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB/host
    value: 2
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the disk each host has, as stated for this case"}

  share:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: percent
    value: 25
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "stated for this case"}

  one_more:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: share + 1

  one_less:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: 2 - share

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - one_more
  - one_less
  - index
  - disk_per_host
files.scenarios/reference.yaml:
scenario: reference
title: Reference
because: the model as declared
samples: 1000
seed: 20260916
overrides: {}

provenance.source: the fleet chosen for this case
